```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(

require(tidyverse)
require(rlang)
require(stargazer)
require( ggthemes )
require(broom)
require(knitr)
require(kableExtra)
require(patchwork)
require(gridExtra)
require(pander)
require(rpart)
require( rpart.plot )
require(RColorBrewer)
require(cowplot)

select <- dplyr::select


my_t = theme_tufte() + 
  theme( legend.position="bottom", 
         legend.direction="horizontal",
         legend.key.width=unit(1,"cm"),
         panel.border = element_blank(), 
         axis.title=element_text(size=12))
theme_set( my_t )


DGP_vars <- c("K", "J.bar", "p.bar", "sd.ATE", "ICC", "variable.p", "n.bar", "sd.cluster", "ICC.cluster", 
                 "size.impact.cor", "num.cov.block","cv.nbar", "R2.cluster", 
                 "num.cov.cluster", "cv.cluster", "num.cov.indiv", 
                 "empirical", "cv.block", "nbar.J.cor", "size.intercept.cor")


source( here::here( "analysis/R/load_and_prep_data.R" ) )

source( here::here( "analysis/R/create_custom_boxplot.R" ) )

source( here::here( "analysis/R/create_analysis_tree.R" ) )

sruns.graph.infl<-sruns.clean  %>% mutate(perc.off.SE.s=abs((mean.SE.hat-SE.s)/SE.s)*100)

sruns.cov<-sruns.clean %>% 
  mutate(cover.s.estimand=cover.s.estimand*100,
         CI.length.norm= (CI.length/CI.length.median))

```


We also ran a separate set of simulations to evaluate how standard errors perform for fully interacted models in matched pairs studies. These simulations were also fully factored and the parameters for those simulations were as follows:

```{r low df checks, cache=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE}

#I've moved all the low df stuff to a section that doesn't print in the document
#it looks like the whole issue was the CRVE 

#When in the low df scenario did the se's run at all
lowdf<-sruns.clean %>% filter(group=="lowdf")
#I want to check and make sure the estimate always ran 
with(lowdf,table(is.na(mean.ATE.hat)))
#yes there are always ATE estimates 
#now checking when the standard errors didn't run 
with(lowdf,table(is.na(mean.SE.hat)))
#which methods are ever missing estimated standard errors
methods_incomplete <- lowdf %>% filter(is.na(mean.SE.hat)) %>% pull(method) %>% unique()

#drop incomplete methods and then make a boxplot of the standard error quality 
inf_plot_lowdf <- create_custom_boxplot2(
  lowdf %>% filter(!(method %in% methods_incomplete)), 
  "inflate.s", 
  "Super Population Estimated Standard Error Accuracy by Method", 
  "Ratio of Estimated SE over True Super SE",
  vline_at=1,
    log_scale = TRUE
)
print(inf_plot_lowdf)


  crve<-lowdf %>% filter(method %in% c("LRcw-FIcw-crve","LR-FIpw-crve")) 
#ok now we're just going to look at the crve estimates and do a tree 
tree10<-create_analysis_tree( crve, 
                            outcome_var = "inflate.s", 
                             predictor_vars = c("block_type_lowdf","J.bar", "cor_J_tau",
                                                "sd.clu", "ICC.clu", "cv.clu", "num.cov", "p.bar"),
                            tree_title = "Decision Tree for Super Population True Standard Error")


#check by 
#pulling the cases missing standard error estimates
na_ids <- lowdf %>% filter(is.na(mean.SE.hat)) %>% pull(ID) %>% unique()


lowdf.complete <- lowdf %>% filter(!(ID %in% na_ids))
lowdf.complete <- lowdf.complete %>% select(all_of(DGP_vars),block_type_lowdf) %>% unique()

lowdf.ncomplete <- lowdf %>% filter((ID %in% na_ids))
lowdf.ncomplete <- lowdf.ncomplete %>% select(all_of(DGP_vars),block_type_lowdf) %>% unique()

with(lowdf,table(J.bar,K))
with(lowdf.complete,table(J.bar,K))
with(lowdf.ncomplete,table(J.bar,K))

#what ran
# everything if K was 7
# none when K was 20
#when J.bar is L and K is 10 than 2 scenarios ran 
#clean up data to add in scenario labels 

#only keep the sets where K==7

lowdf<-lowdf %>% filter(K==7)

incomplete_methods <- c("AR-FIcw-db", "AR-FIcw-het", "ARpw-FIpw-db", 
                       "ARpw-FIpw-het", "LR-FIpw-db", "LRcw-FIcw-db")

sruns.graph.infl.lowdf<-sruns.graph.infl %>% filter( group=="lowdf" & !(method %in% incomplete_methods))


inf_plot <- create_custom_boxplot2(
  sruns.graph.infl.lowdf, 
  "inflate.s", 
  "Super Population Estimated Standard Error Accuracy by Method", 
  "Ratio of Estimated SE over True Super SE",
  vline_at=1,
    log_scale = FALSE
)
print(inf_plot)

cov_plot <- create_custom_boxplot2(
       sruns.cov %>% filter(group=="lowdf" & !(method %in% incomplete_methods)), 
  "cover.s.estimand", 
  "Coverage by Method", 
  "Coverage",
  vline_at=95,
    log_scale = FALSE
)
print(cov_plot)

```
